D: A poor boy finds a golden ticket and tours a mysterious chocolate factory.
P: Serve the drinks when Charlie and Grandpa Joe sneak a taste of the fizzy lifting drinks.
S: the candy cup Wonka bites into
White chocolate set inside small paper cups, peeled, filled with a vanilla mousse, a chocolate handle stuck on the side. Eat the whole thing.
Veruca wants a goose that lays golden eggs, now
Tempered dark chocolate brushed into small egg moulds in two coats, set, filled with salted caramel ganache, joined, then brushed with edible gold lustre until they shine.
Seeded crackers spread with whipped ricotta and topped with a mix of raspberries, blackberries and blueberries crushed with a little sugar.
M: the little house with four grandparents in one bed
Beef shin browned, onion, carrot and potato softened, pearl barley and stock added, braised covered at 160C for 3 hours until thick. Bread to stretch it further.
the room where everything, even the grass, is edible
A big board planted like a garden: toasted marshmallow mushrooms on pretzel stalks, chocolate-dipped strawberries, toffee apple wedges, honeycomb rocks and a cloud of fairy floss in the middle.
W: the sweet that never gets smaller
Layered truffles: a cherry centre wrapped in white chocolate ganache, chilled, then dark ganache, chilled, then rolled in cocoa and coloured sugar so every bite shows a new layer.
K: the drink that floats Charlie up to the fan
Raspberry purée and lemon syrup in a tall glass, topped with very cold soda water and a scoop of lemon sorbet so it fizzes up to the rim.

s.note: the candy cup Wonka bites into
s.how: Brush 200g melted white chocolate inside 8 small paper cups in two coats and set. Peel off the paper. Whip 200ml cream with icing sugar and vanilla bean seeds and fill. Stick on a piped dark chocolate handle. Eat the whole thing.

Crush 100g raspberries, 100g blackberries and 100g blueberries with a spoon of sugar. Spread 16 seeded crackers with 200g whipped ricotta and top with the berries. Taste them and decide what a snozzberry is.

m.note: the little house with four grandparents in one bed
m.how: Brown 800g diced beef shin. Soften 2 onions, 3 carrots and 400g potatoes, add 100g pearl barley and 1.2L stock. Cover and braise at 160C for 3 hours until thick. Serve with bread to stretch it further.

w.note: the sweet that never gets smaller
w.how: Wrap 12 maraschino cherries in white ganache made from 150g white chocolate and 50ml cream, and chill. Wrap again in dark ganache from 150g dark chocolate and 75ml cream, and chill. Roll in cocoa and coloured sugar. Bite to see the layers.

d.note: the drink that floats Charlie up to the fan
d.how: Blitz 150g raspberries and strain. Mix with the juice of 2 lemons and 2 tbsp sugar syrup. Divide between four tall glasses, top with very cold soda water and drop in a scoop of lemon sorbet so it fizzes up. Don't burp.
